_meta.coverage_metric: planted shadowing copy, stale symlink target, and six planted merge defects: a union-shrinking walk, a lost --from, a swallowed disagreement, corrupted bytes, a backup collision, and a blinded directory-symlink audit
_meta.purpose: Prove that shadowing fails loudly, that an unruled duplicate is not a failure, and that a union merge cannot drop, overwrite, auto-select or silently corrupt a file -- all without network access.
_meta.asserted_by: Every covers entry carries the literal string that must appear in tests/verify.sh, and the suite fails if one is missing. It is an anti-drift anchor, not a semantic proof: it guarantees a claim cannot outlive the case that backs it, while the proof that each case is load-bearing is the planted defect it is built around.

runnable.good_fixture: a synthetic shared repo wired to its own surfaces and one subscriber, linked by `install`
runnable.hollow_fixture: the same world with a real copy of a shared name planted in the subscriber's .claude surface, and later with the checkout moved so every symlink is stale

covers.claim: a project copy of a shared name is SHADOWED, because both hosts prefer it silently
a symlink or single-SKILL.md forwarder is a pointer, not a shadow
an unruled duplicate exits 3 rather than failing the gate
adopt sweeps every rival entry to a backup and never deletes
a moved checkout fails WRONG-TARGET instead of resolving somewhere else

runnable.expected: good PASS shared skills hold; hollow SHADOWED/WRONG-TARGET exit 1; unruled exit 3

runnable.good_fixture: three versions of one skill, each carrying a file the other two lack, plus a canonical destination holding a fourth
runnable.hollow_fixture: five patched copies of the script: one that walks only the first version, one that loses the last --from while parsing it, one that files a disagreement as agreement, one that writes bytes no version carries, and one whose directory-symlink audit is neutered so only the recount can catch it

covers.claim: a file only one version carries is in the union, whichever version has it
a dropped file makes the tool itself exit 1, including when the loss happened while parsing --from, because the recount starts from the command line and not from the plan
a shrunken union is never promoted over an existing canonical, which stays byte-for-byte and is not swept aside either
the destination counts as a version of itself, so canonical is diffed and never overwritten
covers.asserted_by: grep -q "canonical wrote a line of its own"

covers.claim: a conflict report prints each side's real byte count, not the word bytes twice
bytes that disagree are diffed hunk by hunk and nothing is auto-selected
a disagreement filed as agreement is caught as UNREPORTED, so a silent auto-selection cannot pass
a union that keeps every path but writes other bytes is caught as ALTERED
an unresolved disagreement exits 3, which is not the exit a dropped file gets
binary disagreement is named as such instead of rendered as an unreadable diff
the superseded destination is moved to a backup, never deleted
a second merge of one name on one day gets its own backup record instead of nesting inside the first
two paths that resolve to one lineage are one version, and having nothing to fold exits 3 with the name of the verb that does apply
a source that is not a directory exits 1, which is not the exit an empty request gets
one name held as a file by one version and as a directory by another is refused in a sentence before anything is written, leaving no staging directory to block the retry
when every file needs a ruling and no canonical exists, nothing is created rather than an empty skill directory
a directory no version fills with a file is reported as not carried, instead of disappearing under exit 0
covers.asserted_by: is an empty directory in A

covers.claim: a subtree reached through a directory symlink is refused before anything is written, rather than dropped under exit 0 because the file walk will not descend a link the empty-directory notice does
that refusal is audited by a walker the recount does not share, so neutering it in the planner still fails the merge instead of publishing a union that lost a subtree

runnable.expected: good UNION with every solo file present; each planted defect DROPPED/UNREPORTED/ALTERED exit 1 with canonical untouched; conflicts exit 3 with the report; nothing to fold exit 3
